sources: GameSkinny, Piece of Heart Locations Guide: https://www.gameskinny.com/tips/a-link-between-worlds-piece-of-heart-locations-guide/
Prima Games, How to Get the Pegasus Boots: https://primagames.com/tips/legend-zelda-link-between-worlds-how-get-pegasus-boots
GamingBolt, A Link Between Worlds Mega Guide: https://gamingbolt.com/the-legend-of-zelda-a-link-between-worlds-mega-guide-collectibles-locations-rupees-more
note: Short directions shown under a check, keyed by check name. Written in our own words from the sources above.

hints.Kakariko Well (Top): Drop into the well from above, northwest Kakariko (Power Glove, or glide in with a Cucco).
hints.Dodge the Cuccos: Cucco Ranch: clear the hardest (rooster) round.
hints.Blacksmith Ledge: Behind the Blacksmith's forge: merge into the right wall and walk north.
hints.[HS] Ledge: Under the Sanctuary: take the west stairs, cross the walkway east, then merge into the wall to the east.
hints.Lost Woods Alcove: North-central Lost Woods: through the hollow log and a narrow merge path.
hints.Hyrule Castle Rocks: Hyrule Castle courtyard, northeast corner: lift the rocks.
hints.Waterfall Cave: Cave behind the waterfall northeast of Irene's house (Flippers).
hints.Rupee Rush (Hyrule): Rupee Rush, west of the Cucco Ranch: collect 100+ rupees (Pegasus Boots).
hints.Hyrule Hotfoot 65s: Hyrule Hotfoot: beat the second time target (65 s).
hints.Eastern Ruins Cave: Cave just south of the Eastern Palace: bomb it open, then merge into the wall and go west.
hints.Eastern Ruins Peg Circle: Southeast Eastern Ruins: hammer the right one of the 10 pegs.
hints.Southern Ruins Pillar Cave: Southern Ruins: between the two big statues, then west (bombs).
hints.Spectacle Rock: Death Mountain, west of Tower of Hera: lower cave entrance.
hints.Floating Island: Top of Hyrule's Death Mountain, next to the fissure. You get there from Lorule's Death Mountain (Fire Rod, Tornado Rod).
hints.Stylish Woman: Kakariko: the locked house, opened from Thieves' Town's fissure. Talk to the woman.
hints.Graveyard Ledge Cave: Take the Sanctuary fissure to Lorule, head south then east, climb the ladder and bomb the rocks to uncover a fissure back to Hyrule's graveyard ledge.
hints.Fortune's Choice: Thieves' Town: win Fortune's Choice (pick the right chest).
hints.Octoball Derby: Lorule: Octoball Derby, score 100 or more points.
hints.Rupee Rush (Lorule): Rupee Rush southwest of Thieves' Town: collect 150+ rupees (Pegasus Boots).
hints.Swamp Cave (Middle): Lorule swamp: cave behind the cracked rock (Big Bomb Flower).
hints.Dark Maze Ledge: Dark Maze on the way to the Dark Palace.
hints.Destroyed House: Lorule woods: merge through the painting in front of Sahasrahla's old house (left side).
hints.n-Shaped House: Flat roof southwest of the ruined house: throw yourself up with a Cucco.
hints.Misery Mire Ledge: Misery Mire: via the weather vane fissure and Hyrule steps (Sand Rod, bombs).
hints.Blacksmith Cave: Cave past the big rock just south of the Blacksmith (Titan's Mitt).
hints.[TR] Left Balcony: Outside Turtle Rock, on its left balcony (Ice Rod).
hints.Fire Cave Pillar: Hyrule's Death Mountain, the volcanic cave past Rosso's Ore Mine: ride the moving smiley-face blocks up (Hammer).
hints.Shady Guy: Kakariko Village, after you've been to Zora's Domain: merge into the wall and come out behind the Shady Guy.
